name: readalong
description: Reads Claude Code replies aloud with a local voice (Kokoro-82M), sentence by sentence, each in its own language: English, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Hindi, German and Dutch. The sentence being read, or each word as it is said, is highlighted, with previous, next, pause, speed and auto-read under the reply, and /readalong for the keyboard.

server.title: Speech server
server.description: Where the speech is made. Left as http://127.0.0.1:8881, by the readalong voice, which runs on this computer. Any other address is a speech server of your own with an OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/speech endpoint that returns WAV; the readalong service plays what it makes.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: Who reads English: heart (Heart, American, the default), emma (Emma, British) or michael (Michael, American, male). A sentence in French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese or Hindi is read by Kokoro's voice for that language, a woman's or a man's as this one is; one in German or Dutch by this voice, with that language's sounds. Pick other to name any voice your speech server has, in Other voice below. The gear menu and /readalong offer the three by name too; a voice picked there is remembered until this changes.

otherVoice.title: Other voice
otherVoice.description: Used only when Voice is other: the voice's name as your speech server knows it, such as af_bella or bm_george for Kokoro. Leave empty otherwise.

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: Starting reading speed, from 0.5 to 2, 1 for normal. A speed picked in the player is remembered until this changes.

highlight.title: Highlight
highlight.description: How the sentence or word being read is marked in the reply: a marker behind it, an underline, or off to leave the reply as drawn.

highlightColor.title: Highlight colour
highlightColor.description: The colour of the marker or the underline. Pick custom to use a colour of your own, then type its hex code (#RRGGBB) in Custom colour below. /readalong shows each colour on a sample sentence before you pick it.

customColor.title: Custom colour
customColor.description: Used only when Highlight colour is custom: a hex code, #RRGGBB or #RGB, such as #FFB3C7. Text on a marker turns dark or white to stay readable.

follow.title: Follow along by
follow.description: What the highlight follows: the sentence being read, or each word as it is said. Words are timed by the readalong voice; with a server that gives no word timings, the sentence is highlighted.

unread.title: Text not read yet
unread.description: While a reply is read, the text after the sentence being read is dim, so what has been read stands out, as a reply being written does. plain leaves the whole reply as it is.

player.title: Audio player
player.description: What plays the sound. auto uses the system's own: Windows' sound player, afplay on macOS, and on Linux the first of pw-play, paplay, aplay and ffplay that works.

startCommand.title: Start command
startCommand.description: auto starts the readalong voice when it does not answer; none starts nothing, for a voice you run yourself. With a speech server of your own, anything but auto and none is run as a shell command to start it when it does not answer.

autoRead.title: Auto-read responses
autoRead.description: Automatically read Claude's responses aloud when they finish.

chime.title: Chime before auto-read
chime.description: Play a soft two-note chime before an answer is read automatically. An answer that finishes while another Claude Code session's answer is being read is not read; with this on, its chime alone tells you it is ready. Reading started with the play button never chimes.
